ForwardedHeaders._comment: Set TrustAllProxies=true ONLY on a PaaS (Render/Fly) where the platform rewrites X-Forwarded-For. Never enable on a directly reachable host. Alternatively list exact proxy IPs in KnownProxies or CIDRs in KnownNetworks.

Email._comment: Provider: resend | brevo | sendgrid | empty (empty = SMTP, for local dev). ApiKey lives only in environment variables (Email__ApiKey).

Ai._comment: Provider: gemini | openai | groq | openrouter | anthropic. ApiKey lives only in environment variables (Ai__ApiKey). With no key the assistant still answers, from the figures held in the database.
